$comment: Outer-loop settings (PROTECTED). Pick an agent with --agent <name>. Commands receive the prompt on stdin.

claude.command: claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits --output-format json --allowedTools "Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,Agent,Skill,Bash(npm run gates*),Bash(npm test *),Bash(npm --prefix *),Bash(npm create @iwsdk@latest *),Bash(npx iwsdk *),Bash(npx tsc *),Bash(npx vitest *),Bash(node scripts/tasks.mjs *),Bash(node tools/xr-harness/*),Bash(git status *),Bash(git diff *),Bash(git log *),Bash(git show *),Bash(git add *),Bash(git commit *)"
claude.notes: Conservative unattended mode. Root package/tooling and governance are protected; dependency/toolchain changes belong to human/pair tasks. No push/branch switching. Widen maxTasks only after real-agent Windows selftests.

claude-auto.notes: Claude Code auto mode (classifier reviews actions). Requires a recent Claude Code; use when the allowlist is too tight for scaffolding tasks.

codex.notes: OpenAI Codex CLI non-interactive; reads AGENTS.md; prompt from stdin. No Claude hooks: the loop's gates are the only enforcement. Its workspace-write sandbox may block network; tasks that run npm install need network access configured per the Codex docs.

mock.notes: Test double used by npm run loop:selftest.
